import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time

from scripts.bench.groebner_measure import FAMILY
listing=index_listing(FAMILY);fp=fingerprint(listing)

if root.with_suffix('.measurement.json').exists():raise SystemExit('retain existing observation')
root.with_suffix('.manifest').write_text(listing)
binary=pathlib.Path('.lake/build/bin/hexgroebner_bench')
cpu,lease=cpu_lease();os.sched_setaffinity(0,{cpu})
metadata=dict(source_fingerprint=fp,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),cpu=cpu,affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),host=os.uname().nodename,load_start=os.getloadavg(),threads=1,toolchain=pathlib.Path('lean-toolchain').read_text().strip(),c_compiler=subprocess.check_output(['cc','--version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],schedule='2 blocks AB/BA; same binary; A separate final tail reductions, B shared symbolic closure and independent triangular solves; every completed sample retained',contract='p=65537, grevlex; identical native row kernels and allowances; candidate only through final interreduction, input generation, certification and kernel checking excluded; decode and full structural basis hashing included',script=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),commands=[])

try:
 for block,order in enumerate(['AB','BA']):
  for case in ['cyclic5','cyclic6','katsura3','reimer5']:
   for arm in order:
    base=pathlib.Path(str(root)+f'-b{block}-{case}-{arm}')

    print(base,'exit',result.returncode,flush=True)
